properties.name: Carlanna Lake
properties.summary: Existing trail from the Carlanna neighborhood to Carlanna Lake. A built mile on the downtown-to-Ward spine.

properties.name: Carlanna to Ward Lake
properties.summary: Conceptual alignment only — not surveyed. The longest gap on the downtown-to-Ward spine, crossing the benches between Carlanna Lake and the Ward drainage.
properties.whatItNeeds: A surveyed line, land-manager agreement (USFS, Borough, and any Trust parcels), and a funded design package.

properties.name: Connell Lake
properties.summary: Existing USFS trail at Connell Lake. The gap is getting here from Ward without walking the road.

properties.name: Connell to Lunch Creek
properties.summary: Conceptual alignment only — not surveyed. Continues the interior corridor from Connell Lake toward Lunch Creek so the north-island trails stop being isolated walk-ins.
properties.whatItNeeds: Survey, USFS review, and a decision on how the line meets existing Lunch Creek tread.

properties.name: Deer Mountain
properties.seasonality: Snow-free late June–September on the upper mountain
properties.summary: The island's signature climb from downtown to the Deer Mountain ridge. Usable today; the gap is what happens after the summit.

properties.name: Deer Mountain to Silvis
properties.summary: Conceptual alignment only — not surveyed. A ridge connection from Deer Mountain toward Silvis Lake. Showing this line is a planning statement, not a route description.
properties.whatItNeeds: A surveyed alpine alignment, a seasonal-use plan, and Forest Service agreement before anyone hangs flagging.

properties.name: Dude Mountain
properties.summary: Existing climb above the north highway. A built destination waiting on a coastal connection that does not require a car.

properties.name: Ella Lake
properties.summary: Existing USFS trail at Ella Lake.

properties.name: Frog Pond
properties.summary: Short existing USFS trail. Kept on the map because residents already use it.

properties.name: Gokachin
properties.summary: Existing USFS trail on the island network inventory.

properties.name: Low Lake / Big Lake
properties.summary: Existing USFS trail between Low Lake and Big Lake.

properties.name: Lunch Creek
properties.summary: Existing USFS trail at Lunch Creek. The northern anchor of the Ward-to-interior corridor.

properties.name: Manzanita Lake
properties.summary: Existing USFS trail at Manzanita Lake.

properties.name: Margaret Trail
properties.summary: Existing USFS trail in the Margaret drainage.

properties.name: Married Man's Trail
properties.summary: Existing downtown boardwalk connection. Alignment is approximate pending the Borough trails layer. On the map because it is how people already move.

properties.name: Minerva Mountain
properties.summary: Existing high-country trail. A built mile that is not yet tied to a named corridor.

properties.name: Naha River National Recreation Trail
properties.seasonality: June–September are the practical hiking months
properties.summary: National Recreation Trail from the floating dock at the head of Naha Bay to Heckman Lake Cabin — boardwalk along Roosevelt Lagoon, then native tread inland past Jordan Lake. Boat- or floatplane-access only, 23 miles north of Ketchikan. The Naha is regionally famous steelhead water.

properties.name: North Tongass coastal connector
properties.summary: Conceptual alignment only — not surveyed. A coastal walking connection along North Tongass so the highway is not the only public route between the north-end communities and the interior trails.
properties.whatItNeeds: Right-of-way conversations with the Borough, State, and shoreline landowners, then a surveyed line. This is not a road project.

properties.name: Perseverance Trail
properties.summary: A historic connection north of town. It exists, but sections are brushed over and the tread is uneven — a built mile that does not yet carry the network.
properties.whatItNeeds: Brushing, tread repair, and a current condition walk with the Forest Service.

properties.name: Pipeline Trail
properties.summary: Existing trail in the Ward drainage. One of the pieces already on the ground between town and the lake.

properties.name: Rainbird to Carlanna
properties.summary: Conceptual alignment only — not surveyed. The missing hillside connection between Rainbird and Carlanna Lake, so downtown does not dead-end at the first neighborhood trail.
properties.whatItNeeds: A surveyed alignment, City and Borough agreement, and a construction package. Do not treat this line as engineered.

properties.name: Rainbird Trail
properties.seasonality: Year-round below the snow line; icy in winter
properties.summary: The downtown hillside trail residents already use. Alignment is approximate until the Borough publishes a trails FeatureServer. South anchor of the downtown-to-Ward spine.

properties.name: Refuge Cove Coastal Trail
properties.summary: Existing coastal trail at Refuge Cove State Recreation Site. Alignment is approximate pending Borough GIS. The built start of the north-highway walking idea.

properties.name: Salvage Trail
properties.summary: Exists but is degraded. Not yet assigned to a priority corridor.
properties.whatItNeeds: Corridor clearing and a decision on whether this remains a local trail or a network link.

properties.name: Schoenbar Trail
properties.summary: Existing in-town trail. Alignment is approximate pending Borough GIS.

properties.name: Silvis Lake
properties.summary: Existing trail to Silvis Lake on the south island. The missing piece is a ridge connection from Deer Mountain.

properties.name: Ward Creek
properties.summary: Existing trail along Ward Creek. The built start of the northbound interior corridor.

properties.name: Ward Lake Nature Trail
properties.summary: The accessible loop at Ward Lake. The destination at the north end of the downtown spine.

properties.name: Ward Lake to Connell
properties.summary: Conceptual alignment only — not surveyed. The gap that keeps Ward Lake and Connell Lake as two separate destinations instead of one interior route.
properties.whatItNeeds: Forest Service review of a surveyed alignment and a clear statement of what the corridor is not: it is not a road.

properties.name: White River Nordic
properties.summary: Existing nordic trail near the Harriet Hunt / White River area.

properties.name: Whitman Trail
properties.summary: Existing south-end trail. Alignment is approximate pending Borough GIS.
